mle.weibull <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & x > 0]
  nll <- function(theta) {
    -sum(stats::dweibull(x, exp(theta[1]), exp(theta[2]), log = TRUE))
  }
  m <- mean(x)
  v <- stats::var(x)
  # Method-of-moments starting values.
  start <- c(log(m / (1 - m)), log(m / v))

  fit <- optim.safe(start, nll, method = "BFGS")
  est <- c(shape = exp(fit$par[1]), scale = exp(fit$par[2]))
  vc <- solve(num.hessian(nll, fit$par))
  se <- est * sqrt(diag(vc))
  list(estimate = est, se = se, loglik = -fit$value)
}

url_keep_query <- function(url, keys) {
  parts <- url_parts(url)
  params <- query_parse(parts$query)

  prefixes <- sub("\\*$", "", keys[endsWith(keys, "*")])
  exact <- keys[!endsWith(keys, "*")]
  drop <- names(params) %in%
    exact |
    vapply(names(params), function(k) any(startsWith(k, prefixes)), logical(1))
  parts$query <- query_build(params[!drop])
  return(url_assemble(parts))
}
